name: Mesh gradient
description: Four colours blended across a slowly warping mesh, mixed in Oklab.

name: Aurora
description: Soft curtains of light drifting over a night sky.

name: Gradient flow
description: Two colours flowing through each other along a warped noise field.

name: Conic sweep
description: A rotating conic gradient with a soft glowing core.

name: Silk
description: Folds of glossy fabric rippling in a slow breeze.

name: Grainy gradient
description: Big soft colour blobs drifting into each other under a fine film grain, filling the frame.

name: Stripe gradient
description: Bands of colour flowing in slow diagonal waves, like the Stripe.com hero, optionally cut by a slanted edge.

name: Holographic gradient
description: Iridescent foil: rainbow bands shifting and shimmering across the frame, with bright sheen streaks.

name: Radial glow
description: Soft radial glows breathing in and out as they drift over a dark background.

name: Liquid marble
description: Veined marble swirling like ink in water (domain-warped noise).

name: Smoke
description: Billowing smoke or cloud drifting upwards.

name: Lava lamp
description: Soft metaballs merging and parting as they rise and fall.

name: Plasma
description: The demoscene classic: interfering sine waves through a colour palette.

name: Caustics
description: Light dancing on the floor of a swimming pool.

name: Flames
description: A wall of fire licking upwards from the bottom edge.

name: Reaction diffusion
description: Turing patterns of spots and labyrinth stripes slowly morphing, like a Gray-Scott simulation or an animal's coat.

name: Cell division
description: Cells in a petri dish under the microscope, growing, pinching and splitting in two.

name: Coral growth
description: Branching coral growing outward from the centre in rings, softly translucent, with glowing growing tips.

name: Veins
description: Branching veins or roots with pulses of light travelling out along them.

name: Ferrofluid
description: A glossy black ferrofluid puddle whose spikes rise as a magnet passes over it, following the pointer.

name: Jellyfish
description: Translucent jellyfish pulsing and drifting up through deep water, trailing glowing tentacles.

name: Fur
description: Soft fur, moss or grass swaying in a breeze, parting around the pointer.

name: Neon fluid
description: Glowing strands of violet, cyan and gold swirling like dye in water, broken into fine grains with a haze of drifting sparks.

name: Molten web
description: A web of white-hot ridges glowing orange through dark cooled rock, slowly drifting and flickering like cracked lava.

name: Iridescent blobs
description: Glossy blobs of liquid chrome with an oil-slick sheen, slowly merging and pulling apart on a dark ground.

name: Spider web
description: An orb web strung across the frame, spokes and a spiral of straight silk threads swaying in the breeze, beaded with glinting dew over soft out-of-focus leaves.

name: Blob morph
description: An organic blob shape-shifting through three forms.

name: Dot wave
description: A halftone grid of dots swelling in a travelling wave.

name: Truchet flow
description: Quarter-circle Truchet tiles forming endless winding paths, with light flowing along them.

name: Hex pulse
description: A honeycomb grid lighting up cell by cell in ripples.

name: Living cells
description: Voronoi cells drifting and dividing, like a microscope slide.

name: Moiré rings
description: Two sets of concentric rings sliding over each other into shimmering interference.

name: Kaleidoscope
description: Mirrored wedges of shifting colour turning around the centre.

name: Stripes
description: Diagonal stripes marching across, for progress bars, banners and warnings.

name: Memphis pattern
description: An 80s Memphis-design field of squiggles, zigzags, triangles, rings, dots and confetti, bobbing, drifting and boiling like hand-drawn ink.

name: Chevron tunnel
description: Two-tone hazard chevrons radiating from a centre point and streaming outward like a tunnel, behind a title card.

name: Neon circuit
description: Glowing neon traces routed up a circuit board, with pulses of light racing along them.

name: Stained glass
description: Jewel-coloured panes of mottled glass set in lead, glowing as the sun moves behind them; a rose window when you want one.

name: Neon worms
description: Glowing neon tubes looping and wriggling across a dark frame, their colour shifting slowly from one end of the screen to the other.

name: Bokeh
description: Out-of-focus city lights drifting softly.

name: God rays
description: Shafts of light fanning down through haze.

name: Sparkles
description: Four-pointed glints twinkling on and off across the frame.

name: Neon ripple
description: Glowing neon rings radiating out from the pointer or the centre.

name: Light ribbons
description: A bundle of thin iridescent light strands weaving across a dark frame.

name: Tarot reveal
description: A face-down tarot card hovering in a golden glow, its back inlaid with a gilt sun, moon and stars, turning over to reveal a picture in a gold frame as dust motes drift up through the light.

name: Prism
description: A white beam striking a glass prism and fanning out the far side as a rainbow through faint haze, the prism rocking so the colours sweep.

name: Prism burst
description: Rainbow rays fanning out from a white-hot core, slowly turning and shimmering, like light split through a prism.

name: Orbit swoosh
description: Glowing comet ribbons circling a title on tilted orbits, dimming and slipping behind it on the far side, shedding flecks of confetti that drift out and fade; a transparent overlay.

name: Tick ring burst
description: A sunburst arc of short rounded ticks popping out one after another from its middle behind a title, holding, then flying outward and fading; a transparent overlay.

name: Swoosh underline
description: A glowing curved stroke sweeping on under a subtitle with a bright head and a thinner second stroke chasing it, then wiping away from its tail; a transparent overlay.

name: Relight
description: A picture relit by a directional light you can swing round and raise, its surfaces read from brightness so they catch the light or fall into shade.

name: Point light
description: A torch moving over a darkened picture, following the pointer while it hovers and drifting on its own otherwise, lighting the surfaces that face it.

name: Studio lighting
description: Three-point lighting on a subject: a warm key from one side, a cool fill from the other and a bright rim tracing its silhouette, against a darkened studio backdrop.

controls.l: Key out the corner colour (0 off)

name: Time of day
description: A picture regraded and relit through the day, from cool dawn through white noon and golden hour to blue hour and a night where its brightest spots glow like lit windows.

name: Gobo projection
description: A theatre light throwing a patterned gobo onto a picture (window panes, foliage, stars, venetian slats or your own text), softly focused and slowly drifting.

controls.l: Gobo (0 window, 1 foliage, 2 stars, 3 slats, 4 gobo image)

name: Neon spill
description: Coloured light spilling onto a picture from a flickering two-colour neon tube, lighting the surfaces that face it and falling off with distance.

name: Candlelight
description: A picture lit only by a warm candle low in the frame, its flicker shifting the light and the deep shadows, with a soft warm bloom.

name: Pool caustics
description: Rippling caustic light reflected from a pool playing across a picture, as on a wall beside the water, in a cool blue-white.

name: Party lights
description: Club lighting over a picture: coloured spot beams cutting through haze and pools of light sweeping across it, with mirror-ball sparkles and an optional strobe.

name: Lamp switch
description: A pendant lamp in a dark room: a click tugs its pull cord, the bulb flickers on and a warm cone of light fades in over the scene; the next click turns it off.

name: Warp starfield
description: Flying through a field of stars, from cruising to warp speed.

name: Nebula
description: Glowing gas clouds and stars drifting in deep space.

name: Event horizon
description: A glowing accretion disc swirling into a black hole.

name: Planet
description: A turning planet, banded gas giant or rocky world, lit from one side with a soft terminator, a scattering atmosphere and optional rings.

name: Spiral galaxy
description: A spiral galaxy seen at a tilt, its arms of blue stars and pink nebulae wound around a warm core and laced with dark dust lanes, turning slowly.

name: Solar system
description: A stylised solar system seen at a tilt: planets circling a glowing sun on their orbit lines, the outer ones slower, one with rings.

name: Shooting star
description: A shooting star streaks across every few seconds, its tail cooling from white to blue, flaring as it burns out and shedding sparks; clicking launches one from the pointer.

name: Meteor shower
description: A night sky over a hilly, wooded horizon with the Milky Way, as meteors streak outward from one radiant point, the far ones short, the odd one a bright fireball.

name: Comet
description: A comet hanging in the night sky: a bright head in a glowing coma, a broad curving dust tail and a straight blue ion tail whose streamers stream away from the sun.

name: Northern lights
description: Aurora curtains rippling over a pine-covered skyline, green at their foot and red at their crown, with fine rays drifting along them and the whole sky mirrored in a still lake.

name: Satellite pass
description: A satellite gliding steadily across a starry sky over a dark skyline, brightening overhead and fading into Earth's shadow; a train of them, a sudden flare or a long-exposure streak.

name: Star trails
description: A long-exposure night sky: every star draws an arc round the celestial pole as the sky turns, coloured by its temperature, over a dark treeline.

name: Neon warp
description: Pink and cyan light streaks rushing out from a dark centre, as if jumping to hyperspace, leaving room in the middle for a title.

name: Synthwave
description: A neon perspective grid racing towards a striped retro sun.

name: Digital rain
description: Columns of glyph-like characters raining down a terminal.

name: Dithered gradient
description: A 1-bit Bayer-dithered gradient wave, like an old Mac or Game Boy screen.

name: TV static
description: Analogue snow with rolling bars and scanlines.

name: 8-bit
description: An image on a chunky pixel grid, reduced to a classic console or computer palette with ordered Bayer dithering.

controls.l: Palette (0 Game Boy, 1 PICO-8, 2 NES, 3 CGA, 4 C64, 5 1-bit)

name: Game Boy screen
description: An image on a handheld's green dot-matrix LCD: four shades, a visible pixel grid and smeary ghosting, inset in an olive bezel.

name: Pixel fire
description: Chunky Doom-style pixel fire licking up from the bottom through a stepped black, red, orange, yellow and white ramp.

name: Pixel landscape
description: A parallax pixel-art landscape: clouds, snowy mountains, hills and pines scrolling at different speeds under a pixel sun or moon.

name: Outrun road
description: A pseudo-3D arcade racer's road curving toward a striped sunset sun, with rumble strips, stripe bands and roadside poles rushing past.

name: Palette cycle
description: Demoscene colour cycling: a still pixel-art waterfall (or plasma) brought to life purely by rotating its palette.

name: Raster bars
description: Demoscene copper bars bouncing on sine paths behind a sine-scrolling greeting, all in chunky pixels.

name: Tape loading
description: An 8-bit computer loading from tape: chaotic colour stripes racing through the border around a blue screen with a blinking cursor under READY.

name: Pixel water
description: Tiling pixel-art water in three blues with wavy highlight lines and twinkling sparkles; it loops and tiles seamlessly.

name: Pixel sort
description: Glitch-art pixel sorting: runs of pixels between two brightness thresholds are sorted dark to bright, smearing the picture into streaks that shift as the threshold breathes.

controls.l: Brightest toward (0 down, 1 up, 2 right, 3 left)

name: LED wall
description: An image on a stadium LED board: round diodes on a black grid with stepped brightness, soft bloom, sun louvres, the odd dead diode and a rolling scan band.

name: Subpixel zoom
description: A macro zoom in and out of a screen: the picture breaks into its pixels and then into glowing red, green and blue subpixels, as LCD stripes, PenTile diamonds or CRT phosphor triads.

controls.l: Layout (0 LCD stripes, 1 PenTile, 2 CRT triads)

name: Brick mosaic
description: An image rebuilt from toy bricks with studs, ironed fuse beads or cross-stitch on cloth, in a few flat colours, built up row by row from the bottom.

name: Pixel sprites
description: A field of little procedurally generated pixel creatures, each mirror-symmetric with an outline and blinking eyes, bobbing in place and swapping for new ones now and then.

name: Pixel city
description: A night-time pixel skyline in parallax: three rows of towers with windows flicking on and off, blinking aerials, stars, a crescent moon and car lights along the street.

name: Pixel text
description: Any text set in a chunky 5 × 7 pixel font, its letters dropping in one after another with a little bounce.

name: Coin spin
description: An 8-bit gold coin spinning on the spot, a pixel sparkle glinting and a +1 popping up each turn.

name: Space invader
description: The classic two-frame pixel invader marching across and down a step, dropping a blinking zigzag laser shot.

name: Heart health bar
description: A row of pixel hearts as a game health bar: two hearts flash and empty as damage lands, then pop back full.

name: RPG dialog
description: A role-playing game's text box: a pixel-bordered panel with a speaker's name tab slides up, the line types out letter by letter in a pixel font, and a continue arrow blinks.

controls.d: WELCOME, TRAVELLER! THE ROAD AHEAD IS DANGEROUS. TAKE THIS.

texts.name: text
texts.label: Text
texts.default: WELCOME, TRAVELLER! THE ROAD AHEAD IS DANGEROUS. TAKE THIS.

name: LED ticker
description: A dot-matrix LED sign with any text marching across it a column at a time, its lit dots glowing over the dim unlit ones, in a seamless loop.

name: Ripple
description: An image rippling as if seen through water, from the pointer or the centre.

name: Glitch
description: Digital glitch on an image: RGB split, slice displacement and blocky corruption in bursts.

name: Duotone
description: An image mapped onto two colours, from its shadows to its highlights. For the gliding glare it used to have, lay `glare-sweep` over it.

name: Halftone
description: An image printed as rotated halftone dots, breathing slightly.

name: Pixel reveal
description: An image resolving from big blocks to full detail, then back, in a loop.

name: Ken Burns
description: A slow documentary-style pan and zoom across an image, easing in and out and back again.

name: ASCII art
description: An image drawn as text characters picked by brightness, in one ink or the picture's own colours.

name: Shatter
description: An image breaking into glass-like shards that fly apart, spin and reassemble in a loop.

name: Melt
description: An image melting and dripping downwards in slow, noisy runs.

name: Risograph
description: An image printed in two posterized, slightly misregistered inks on grainy paper.

name: Thermal
description: An image seen through a heat camera or night-vision goggles.

name: Edge glow
description: An image's edges traced as glowing neon lines over a dimmed picture, with a travelling pulse.

name: Tilt-shift
description: An image blurred outside a sharp horizontal band, with punchy colour, so it looks like a miniature.

name: Slit-scan
description: An image smeared into time-stretched streaks, like a slit-scan photograph.

name: Mosaic flip
description: Hexagonal or triangular tiles flipping over from the left to reveal an image, then back.

name: Chromatic lens
description: An image through a cheap wide lens: barrel distortion and colour fringes growing towards the edges.

name: Oil paint
description: An image repainted in flat, edge-keeping brush dabs, like an oil painting.

name: Chroma key
description: A green- or blue-screen keyer: the screen turns clear (or the backdrop colour) with a soft edge, the screen colour bounced onto the subject is taken back out, and shadows cast on the screen can stay as see-through shade.

name: LUT grade
description: A colour grade from a 3D LUT image (or a built-in teal & orange, punchy or film noir look) that leaves skin tones alone, so faces keep their colour under a heavy grade.

controls.l: LUT image (n³ colours: n × n tiles, or Hald)
Look without a LUT (1 teal & orange, 2 punchy, 3 film noir)

images.name: uLut
images.label: LUT image (n³ colours: n × n tiles, or Hald)

name: Scratch card
description: A scratch-off ticket: a coin scrapes its silver foil away row by row, flecks and curled edges and all, to reveal a picture, which shines once uncovered before the foil seals back over.

name: Polaroid develop
description: An instant photo sliding onto the table and given a shake, its picture developing out of murky blue-green to full, slightly faded colour inside the white frame.

name: Pixelate censor
description: Part of a picture or video hidden behind big mosaic blocks, as for a face or a number plate, the blocks shimmering like a live censor.

name: Blur censor
description: Part of a picture or video blurred beyond recognition, as for a face or a screen, or everything but it blurred for focus.

name: Scramble censor
description: Part of a picture or video broken into shuffled, flipped blocks with digital noise, reshuffling several times a second.

name: Redaction bars
description: Black marker bars drawn one after another over lines of a picture, like a redacted document, then wiped away.

name: Pencil sketch
description: A picture redrawn in pencil on paper: graphite outlines and streaky shading strokes that cross as it darkens, in grey or coloured pencil.

name: Watercolour
description: A picture painted in watercolour: soft washes in a few layers that bleed past their edges, pigment pooled dark where a wash dries and granulated in the paper's tooth, over a faint pencil underdrawing.

name: Pen and ink
description: A picture drawn with a pen: cross-hatched lines that build up as it darkens, stippled dots, or engraved lines that swell and bend with the forms, like a woodcut or banknote.

name: Charcoal
description: A picture drawn in smudgy, high-contrast charcoal: broad streaky strokes that catch on the paper's tooth and heavy dark edges, or in chalk on a blackboard, or in colour as waxy crayon or soft pastel.

controls.l: Draw the lights, not the darks

name: Sketch reveal
description: A picture drawn before your eyes: pencil outlines sweep in stroke by stroke, shading follows, then colour washes in from a wet edge until the finished picture holds and fades back to paper.

name: CRT screen
description: An image on a curved CRT: scanlines, shadow mask, bloom and flicker.

name: Film look
description: An image graded like film: grain, gate weave, halation and vignette.

name: Stained glass picture
description: A picture remade as a stained-glass window: each pane takes the picture's colour where it sits, mottled, lit from behind and set in lead.

name: Skin smoothing
description: Skin in a portrait or live video evened out, blemishes and blotches softened, while eyes, brows and lips stay sharp and some fine texture is kept.

name: Dewy glow
description: A soft, warm glow blooming from the highlights of skin, with a sheen on its brightest parts, for a fresh, dewy look.

name: Soft focus
description: A dreamy diffusion-filter look: highlights bleed softly into the picture, contrast eases and the shadows lift in a faint haze.

name: Brighten eyes and teeth
description: The whites of the eyes or a smile brightened and whitened in a region, the yellow taken out, while the skin round them is left alone.

name: Lip tint
description: Lipstick laid on lips in a region: any shade, as sheer or as deep as you like, with a wet gloss along the lower lip, the lips' texture showing through.

name: Blush
description: A soft flush of colour on both cheeks, fading out at the edges, any shade, the skin's texture showing through.

name: Eyeshadow
description: Two-tone eyeshadow on both lids, deepest at the lash line and outer corners and blended up to the crease, with an optional twinkling shimmer.

controls.l: Skin only (keeps eyes and lashes bare)

name: Highlighter
description: A luminous sheen on both cheekbones, its finely milled glitter twinkling as the light catches it.

name: Retouch reveal
description: A portrait split by a sweeping divider: as it was on one side, retouched on the other, skin smoothed, glowing and warmed.

name: Product shine
description: A bright glint sweeping across a product shot, then four-point sparkles twinkling on it in turn, as in a cosmetics ad.

name: Lipstick swipe
description: A creamy lipstick swatch swiped across the frame with a glossy streak along it, then the shade's name fading in beneath.

name: Swatch reveal
description: A row of shade swatches popping in one after another with a satin sheen, each with its name fading in below, like a cosmetics range.

name: Rain on glass
description: Raindrops sliding down a window in fits and starts, leaving beaded trails behind them.

name: Snowfall
description: Layers of snowflakes drifting down on the wind, the far ones smaller and softer.

name: Lens flare
description: An anamorphic lens flare: a long horizontal streak and a chain of ghosts through the centre, following the pointer.

name: Vignette & grain
description: Darkened corners and fine animated film grain to lay over any picture.

name: Scanline sweep
description: A bright scanning line with a glow and fading trail passing across, like a scanner or hologram.

name: Spotlight
description: Darkness everywhere but a soft circle of light that follows the pointer or wanders on its own.

name: Embers
description: Glowing sparks rising from below, swaying and flickering out as they cool.

name: Shine sweep
description: A soft diagonal gloss band gliding across now and then, for cards and buttons.

name: Glare sweep
description: A soft diagonal glare gliding across without a pause, added light to lay over a picture (with plus-lighter blending it adds exactly).

name: Frost creep
description: Ice crystals creeping in from the edges of the frame and melting back.

name: Cobweb corners
description: Dusty, tattered cobwebs strung across the corners of the frame, their threads sagging and gently stirring, with loose strands hanging down: a spooky overlay for a page or picture.

name: Viewfinder
description: A camera viewfinder over the picture: corner brackets, a blinking REC light and a running timecode.

name: Shader text
description: A title filled with a living texture (plasma, fire, caustics or liquid chrome), with a soft glow and outline.

name: Glass text
description: A title cast in glass over a picture, bending and splitting what is behind it, while a beam of light sweeps through the letters and breaks into a faint rainbow at their edges.

name: Chrome text
description: A title in polished or brushed metal: its bevels reflect a studio sky and dark ground split by a bright horizon, and a glint sweeps across the letters.

name: Iridescent text
description: A title in rainbow chrome: thin-film colours swirl over bevelled letters with bright white rims, a soft rainbow halo, and star glints twinkling at the edges.

name: Drip text
description: A chunky outlined title popping in, then oozing slime drips from its letters; Inline sets it in a line of text.

name: Typewriter
description: Letters typed out one at a time behind a block caret, which then blinks.

texts.label: Font

name: Scramble text
description: Random glyphs flickering, then settling into the real word letter by letter, left to right.

name: Kinetic stagger
description: Each letter springs up into place in turn, rising, turning and overshooting, then an underline sweeps beneath.

name: Word bounce
description: A caption's words spring up one after another, each overshooting in scale with an elastic wobble before it settles.

name: Karaoke sweep
description: A caption shown whole in an outlined base colour, with a highlight colour wiping left to right across it a word at a time, like karaoke lyrics.

name: Word pop
description: Social-video captions: each word in turn pops on from small with a quick tilt, then snaps to rest, lit in a highlight colour until the next word lands. Earlier words stay.

controls.d: Captions that pop on every word

texts.name: text
texts.label: Text
texts.default: Captions that pop on every word

name: Neon sign
description: Glowing neon tube lettering that stutters on, then keeps one faulty letter buzzing.

name: Stroke draw text
description: A word's outline traced on along every letter, then its fill fading in.

name: Split reveal
description: A line draws across, then the title's top half rises out from behind it while the bottom half drops down.

name: Highlighter
description: A marker swipe drawn left to right behind a phrase, rough-edged like a real highlighter pen.

name: Word cycle
description: A fixed lead-in with the last word rolling through alternatives like a slot machine, an underline resizing to each.

name: Liquid fill
description: A title filling up with liquid, its wavy surface rising through the letters.

name: Glitch text
description: A title breaking up in bursts: red and cyan copies split apart and slices of the letters jump sideways.

name: Extruded text
description: Retro 3D block lettering: stacked shaded layers extrude out of the title and swing as the light moves.

name: Text on a path
description: Words gliding along a curve, in at its start and out at its end; give it any SVG path to follow.

name: Circle text
description: Words set round a circle, repeated to close the ring, turning slowly round a mark: a badge or a seal.

name: Zalgo text
description: A title that something corrupts: combining marks creep over and under its letters in fits, then overrun it in a tangle with a red echo shuddering behind, before it snaps back to plain.

name: Fogged mirror writing
description: Words traced by an unseen finger on a fogged-up mirror, the dark glass showing through each stroke as it is drawn, beads of condensation running down from them, then the fog creeping back over until they are gone.

name: Scratched text
description: Words gouged into a dark surface in a few frantic passes, each scratch a little off the last, the pale gouges filling in behind them, then fading as if they had never been there.

name: Ransom note
description: A message spelled out in letters cut from magazines, each on its own scrap of paper in its own face, size and tilt, slapped down one after another, then torn away.

name: Carved pumpkin text
description: Letters carved through the ribbed orange skin of a pumpkin, a candle inside lighting them up from within, flickering, its glow spilling round the cuts, until it gutters out.

name: Feature morph
description: The classic face morph: two pictures warp so five matching points (eyes, mouth, chin, hairline) meet while they cross-fade.

name: Silhouette morph
description: One silhouette or logo flowing into another as a gooey blob, its colour blending from the first shape's to the second's.

name: Shape morph
description: Any two SVG paths morphing into each other and back, their fill and outline colours blending along.

name: Icon toggle
description: A round button whose icon morphs between two states (play and pause, menu and close, sun and moon) with a little pop.

name: Morph sequence
description: One shape flowing from circle to star to heart to hexagon and round again, its colour changing with each.

name: Gooey morph
description: A cluster of liquid drops melting into a star, splitting into two blobs and beading back into drops.

name: Particle morph
description: A shape bursting into dots along its outline that swirl across and settle into a second shape, then back.

name: Digit morph
description: A number counting from one value to another, each digit's stroke bending smoothly into the next.

name: Click ripple
description: Rings of water spreading out from every click and fading as they go.

name: Click burst
description: Sparks or confetti bursting out of every click, falling under gravity as they fade.

name: Cursor glow
description: A soft light following the pointer, with a halo ring that tightens while it is pressed.

name: Liquid hover
description: An image that swells and ripples like liquid around the pointer while it hovers.

name: X-ray reveal
description: A second image showing through a soft lens around the pointer that grows as it hovers and pulses on click.

name: Magnifier
description: A round magnifying glass over an image at the pointer, with a bright rim and a fringe of colour at its edge.

name: Holo card
description: A holographic foil trading card whose rainbow sheen and glare shift as the pointer tilts it.

name: Card flip
description: A card that turns over in perspective on hover to show its back, lifting as it goes, a lit edge showing side-on and its shadow narrowing under it.

name: Press to charge
description: A ring that fills and glows while the pointer is held and drains when it is let go, bursting if it was fully charged.

name: Hover swap
description: One image burning away into another from the pointer as it hovers, along a glowing ragged edge.

name: Condensation wipe
description: A picture behind fogged-up glass dotted with droplets; the pointer wipes clear streaks that mist over again, and a few drips run down.

controls.l: Wipe on its own when idle

name: Web shot
description: A line of silk shoots from the bottom of the frame to every click and bursts into a sticky web splat that hangs there, then fades.

name: Before and after
description: Two pictures compared either side of a divider with a round handle that follows the pointer while it hovers and sweeps back and forth when idle; a cut-out shows over a transparency checkerboard.

name: Cursor-follow eyes
description: A row of eyes whose pupils follow the pointer wherever it goes while it hovers, narrowing as it comes close and blinking now and then, wandering on their own while idle; a transparent overlay.

name: Mirror mismatch
description: A picture beside its reflection in an old framed mirror; both lean towards the pointer, but the reflection follows half a second late, and every so often it stops following and does something of its own.

name: Like button
description: A heart that fills with a springy pop, a ring and a burst of particles as its like count ticks up, and empties again on the next click.

name: Toggle switch
description: A switch whose knob slides across, squashing a little mid-slide, as the track blends to its on colour; the next click slides it back.

name: Checkbox
description: A labelled checkbox that fills with a press and draws its tick on, then undraws it and empties on the next click.

name: Menu toggle
description: A hamburger menu button whose three bars morph into a close cross as it spins half a turn, and back on the next click.

name: Bookmark
description: A bookmark that hops and fills from top to bottom when saved, then drains and dips when unsaved.

name: Copy button
description: A copy button whose icon shrinks away for a drawn check and a “Copied!” label, turning back by itself a moment later.

name: Send button
description: A send button whose paper plane winds up and flies off up and to the right as the label turns to “Sent” with a check, then it resets.

name: Download button
description: A round download button whose arrow drops and morphs into a progress ring that fills, ends on a check, then resets.

name: Link hover
description: A text link whose underline grows from left to right on hover, its arrow nudging right as the text changes colour.

name: Button hover fill
description: An outlined pill button that fills with a slanted sweep from the left on hover, its label inverting colour as the fill passes.

name: Tooltip pop
description: A small help badge that pops a tooltip bubble up above it on hover, rising and fading in with a slight overshoot.

name: Press button
description: A chunky 3D button whose face pushes down onto its base while held, its shadow tightening, and springs back up on release.

name: Toast notification
description: A toast card that slides in from the top right with a slight overshoot, draws a tick in its badge as its timer bar runs down, then slides away by itself.

name: Slider scrub
description: A labelled slider whose knob a cursor grabs and drags along the track, the fill and value readout counting with it, settling with a small bounce before it glides back.

name: Card fan
description: A squared-up hand of five playing cards that fans open on an arc on hover, the middle card rising, and gathers back when the pointer leaves.

name: Haunted hover
description: A button that will not be touched: on hover it flinches away from the pointer, tipping and trembling, leaving a ghostly outline where it was; it settles back when the pointer leaves.

name: Fireworks
description: Shells rising on faint trails and bursting into peonies, chrysanthemums, gold willows and rings that droop and twinkle out; clicks fire more.

name: Sparkler
description: A burning sparkler throwing crackling, forking spark streaks from its glowing tip, which follows the pointer when it hovers.

name: Explosion
description: A fireball cooling from white-hot to orange to rolling dark smoke, with a shockwave ring and flying debris; it loops and also goes off at each click.

name: Spark fountain
description: A gerb spraying sparks up from its base in a column that arcs over and falls back, lighting the ground.

name: Roman candle
description: Balls of coloured fire popping up from a tube one after another, trailing comet tails and sputtering sparks.

name: Fuse burn
description: A lit fuse burning along an S-curve, its bright spitting spark leaving a charred, smoking cord behind, then a pop.

name: Smoke bomb
description: Billowing two-tone coloured smoke pouring from a point, rolling out along the ground and rising as it thins.

name: Light show
description: A stadium pyro finale: flame jets and spark gerbs firing from the stage edge in sequences under sweeping beams, for title cards.

name: Firework burst
description: A small firework for success moments: a flash, a ring of streaks and a staggered ring of dots bursting outwards and fading.

name: Time echo
description: A swaying picture trailed by fading, tinted ghost echoes of where it just was.

name: Chrono split
description: Red, green and blue each lagging a little further behind in time, so movement leaves colour fringes.

name: Time slice
description: Bands of a moving picture each showing a different moment, staggered like a time-displacement.

name: VHS rewind
description: A tape playing, then rewinding fast with tracking noise, jittering lines, colour bleed and a ◀◀ display.

name: Bullet time
description: A shockwave sweeping out from the centre or a click, freezing the picture grey and zoomed behind it while the rest moves on.

name: Time tunnel
description: A picture wrapped round a spiralling tunnel rushing at the viewer, with light streaks and a blazing core.

name: Speed ramp
description: A panning picture lurching from a crawl to a blur and back, motion-blurred in proportion to its speed.

name: Stutter freeze
description: A moving picture that catches in irregular bursts, holding or stuttering frames with a flash on each freeze.

name: Time-lapse clock
description: A clock whose hands race round while the sky behind turns from day to dusk, night and dawn.

name: Drip melt
description: An image melting from the top edge down: columns slump, thick glossy drips run down and pool in a puddle, then it all reforms.

name: Heat haze
description: A mirage shimmer rising off a hot image: wavering refraction strongest near the ground, with a warm tint and a faint reflection.

name: Wax melt
description: A silhouette softening like warm wax: its edges round off, its top sags and it slumps into a glossy puddle, then sets again.

name: Melting text
description: Letters sagging and stretching downwards as long glossy drips run from their bottoms and droplets break off and fall.

name: Liquify
description: An image pushed and smeared like wet paint by a moving brush (or the pointer), the smears slowly relaxing back.

name: Melting clock
description: A pocket-watch face draped over a ledge like Dalí's soft clocks, its lower half hanging and stretching as the hands keep turning.

name: Lava flow
description: Glowing molten rock oozing downhill, dark cooling crust plates cracking apart over bright flowing lava.

name: Ice cube melt
description: An ice cube softening, slumping and spreading into a glossy puddle with a couple of drips, then freezing back into a cube.

name: Candle
description: A candle burning down with a flickering flame and halo while wax drips run down its sides, then it is lit anew.

name: Lightning
description: Branching lightning striking from the top on a random schedule and wherever you click, lighting up the sky and leaving an afterglow.

name: Tesla arc
description: A jittering plasma arc between two electrodes with stray filaments and sparks at the ends; hover and one end follows the pointer.

name: Plasma ball
description: A plasma globe whose writhing filaments reach from a glowing electrode to the glass and gather where the pointer is.

name: Electric border
description: Electricity crackling round a rounded frame and now and then arcing off it, for cards and buttons.

name: Electric text
description: A word with electricity crawling over its outlines and arcs leaping between its letters, flickering on a dark background.

name: Jacob's ladder
description: An arc climbing between two diverging rods, stretching and breaking at the top, then striking again at the bottom.

name: Short circuit
description: A sparking fault spitting irregular bursts of hot sparks that fall away, with bright flashes and a wisp of smoke.

name: Power surge
description: A picture jolted by a power surge: a flash, an arc tearing across, scanlines and colour split, then a brownout before it settles.

name: Electric field
description: Field lines between glowing positive and negative charges with dashes flowing along them; hover and one charge follows the pointer.

name: Zap icon
description: A lightning bolt icon that draws itself on, flashes with a burst of glow and sparks, then settles.

name: Power button
description: A power button that lights up with a glow ring and its on colour when clicked, and dims again on the next click.

name: Fire border
description: Flames rising off a rounded frame, licking up its sides and tallest along the top, with sparks flying up, for cards, buttons and hot deals.

name: Flaming text
description: Words on fire: flames rising off the letters, which smoulder like coals with glowing cracks, and sparks drifting up.

name: Burn away
description: A picture catching fire and burning away from a point: the paper browns and chars ahead of a glowing, flaming edge that leaves nothing behind, then it is whole again.

name: Ring of fire
description: A hoop of fire, flames rising off a ring and roaring up its top, for avatars, badges and portals; hover and it flares.

name: Fireball
description: A roiling ball of fire streaming flames and sparks behind it as it swoops about; hover and it follows the pointer, its flames rising when it stops.

name: Campfire
description: A crackling campfire at night: flames dancing over crossed logs with glowing embers, sparks spiralling up into the dark and firelight flickering on the ground.

name: Flame icon
description: A flame icon flickering in three layers with a pulsing glow and embers rising off its tip, for streaks, trending and hot items.

name: Match strike
description: A match struck along the side of its box: a spray of sparks, a flame that flares and settles, flickers as the stick chars, then is blown out in a curl of smoke.

name: Hologram
description: A picture or video projected as a flickering hologram: its plain background keyed out, the rest tinted light in drifting scanlines with glowing edges, glitching tears and an emitter's beam below, rebuilding itself line by line if you like.

name: Hologram text
description: Words hovering as a hologram above an emitter: glowing outlines over a translucent fill, scanlines drifting up, flickers and glitching tears.

name: Hologram projector
description: A wireframe globe, cube or icosahedron turning in the light cone of a hologram emitter, its far side dimmer, a scan band sweeping up through it.

name: Holo HUD
description: A holographic heads-up display: tick rings turning both ways, a radar sweep lighting blips as it passes, and a readout counting up round a progress ring, all in a glow.

name: Holo panel
description: A holographic info panel that unfolds from a line of light, writes its title and readings in with decoding letters, flickers as a scan passes over, then folds away.

name: Paint splatter
description: Glossy paint splats landing in layers of a few colours, each a blob with spiky rays, satellite drops and thin flung streaks, slowly fading; clicks throw more.

name: Ink splash
description: A drop of ink hitting still water and blooming into a swirling cloud of curling tendrils that sinks and clears.

name: Splash crown
description: A milk-drop coronet: a drop falls, a crown of liquid rises with beads on its points and falls back into rippling rings.

name: Goo splat
description: Bright, glossy slime splatting onto the glass with a wobble and running down in drips with fat beads on their ends; clicks splat more.

name: Paint roller
description: A paint roller sweeping down the frame, laying a new picture or colour over the old with a stippled, textured edge and thin drips running ahead.

name: Water splash
description: Drops falling onto a water line and throwing up a jet and clear, glinting droplets that arc back down into small ripples.

name: Slime curtain wipe
description: Thick, glossy slime pouring down from the top with a wobbling front and long beaded drips until it covers the frame, then sliding off in stretchy strings to reveal the next picture.

name: Gooey frame
description: A wobbling rim of glossy slime round a rounded frame, with drips swelling on its edges, sliding down and dropping off in beads, for cards and buttons.

name: Goo vortex
description: Two glossy ribbons of goo spiralling in round the centre, coiling into a ball and flinging out to splat round the frame, an intro on a loop.

name: Splat stamp
description: A dot that bursts into an irregular paint splat, droplets popping out round it before it settles and shrinks back.

name: Slime drop
description: A drippy slime title falling in from above, squashing flat as it lands in a puddle and splashing droplets out round it that stay as specks.

name: Soap bubbles
description: Iridescent soap bubbles drifting and wobbling, with swirling thin-film colours, a window highlight and clear centres, popping into droplets at clicks or on their own.

name: Underwater bubbles
description: Bubbles rising and wobbling over a picture tinted blue-green, with caustic light rippling across it.

name: Fizz
description: Carbonation: tiny bubbles streaming up in columns from nucleation points, growing and speeding up as they rise through the drink.

name: Foam
description: Dense suds of packed bubbles in many sizes, shaded and faintly iridescent, settling slowly as some pop and their neighbours close in.

name: Bubble wrap
description: A sheet of bubble wrap seen from above: click a bubble to pop it flat and crinkled, and it fills back up after a while.

name: Lava bubbles
description: Molten bubbles swelling out of a glowing, cracked lava crust and bursting into bright craters with spatter.

name: Chat bubble
description: A chat message bubble popping in with an overshoot and its text typing in, then a reply bubble with bouncing typing dots.

controls.d: Hey! Are we still on for tonight?

texts.name: text
texts.label: Message
texts.default: Hey! Are we still on for tonight?

name: Holo foil sticker
description: A die-cut sticker cut from any shape's outline, with a thick white border, a drop shadow and holographic foil whose rainbow and sparkles shift as the pointer tilts it.

name: Sticker peel reveal
description: A picture peels back like a sticker from its bottom-right corner, rolling diagonally over itself with a curl highlight and shadow, to reveal a second picture underneath. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Sticker slap
description: A die-cut sticker with a label that flicks up and slaps back down from big with a twist, overshooting and settling as its shadow tightens; every click slaps it again.

name: Sticker peel
description: A square die-cut sticker whose corner curls up on hover, showing its paper-white backing and the shadow under the lifted flap, and lies back down after.

name: Holo sticker
description: A holographic die-cut sticker whose rainbow foil sweeps round and round under a white border, with a sheen passing over and sparkles glinting.

name: Sticker sheet
description: A sheet of six little die-cut stickers popping onto the backing one after another, each with its own tilt, like a sticker pack being opened.

name: Stamp badge
description: A rubber stamp that thumps down onto the page with a squash, leaving a tilted badge in grungy, patchy ink; the next click lifts it off again.

name: Washi tape
description: A strip of translucent patterned washi tape unrolling across the page from its roll, with torn ends and the paper showing through.

name: Seal badge
description: A scalloped seal sticker (a "NEW" or "UPDATE LIVE" price-tag burst) turning slowly under upright one- or two-line text, pulsing now and then as a glint sweeps across its face.

name: Comet trail
description: A bright comet head on the pointer with a glowing tail that tapers and fades through where it has just been, shading from head to tail colour.

name: Ribbon trail
description: A shiny two-tone ribbon flowing smoothly after the pointer, twisting over to show its other side as it goes.

name: Sparkle trail
description: Twinkling sparkles and four-point stars shed along the pointer's path, each drifting down a little as it fades out.

name: Brush trail
description: An ink brush stroke following the pointer, bristle-streaked and breaking up dry at its tail, thinner where it moves faster.

name: Ghost trail
description: Afterimages of a circle, ring or star stamped along the pointer's path, each fainter, smaller and shifted in hue than the one before.

name: Light painting
description: Long-exposure light painting in the dark: the pointer leaves neon tubes with white-hot cores that cycle through colour along the stroke and fade slowly.

name: Motion streak
description: A ball or star whizzing in, easing to a stop with a squash, then easing off again, a motion-blur streak and speed lines stretching behind it while it is fast.

name: Dotted trail
description: A staggered line of dots, like footsteps or breadcrumbs, stepping one by one along a curvy path and fading out behind, on a loop.

name: Flow particles
description: Thousands of tiny particles streaming along a swirling curl-noise flow field, coloured by how fast they go.

name: Magnetic swarm
description: A swarm of glowing particles orbiting an attractor that chases the pointer, flung outward by every click.

name: Dust in light
description: Dust motes drifting slowly through a diagonal beam of light, sharp at one depth and soft discs nearer or farther.

name: Boids
description: Flocks of small birds or arrows wheeling across the sky in coherent groups that split apart and merge again.

name: Particle text
description: A title that dissolves into drifting particles, letter by letter, and gathers back into place, on a loop.

name: Confetti cannon
description: Confetti blasting out of both bottom corners and every click in arcs, then flipping and fluttering down.

name: Fireflies
description: Fireflies wandering over a dusky meadow, each blinking on and off in its own rhythm and drifting towards the pointer.

name: Plexus web
description: A web of glowing points drifting in the dark, each strung to its neighbours by fine lines that brighten as they close in and fade as they part.

name: Rubble fall
description: Chunks of rock and concrete tumbling down, bouncing in puffs of dust and settling on a heap of rubble.

name: Glass shatter
description: A picture that cracks like a pane of glass where you click, its shards falling away and spinning before it mends.

name: Crumbling text
description: Stone letters cracking into chunks from one side, the chunks falling away into dust before the word rebuilds.

name: Paper shreds
description: Strips of shredded paper with faint lines of print fluttering down, twisting and flipping as they fall.

name: Leaves blowing
description: Autumn leaves of several shapes blown across in gusts, tumbling and flipping over as they go.

name: Sand erosion
description: A shape of packed sand eroded grain by grain by the wind from one side, the grains streaming away before it reforms.

name: Shockwave
description: A picture hit by a shockwave from each click: a refracting ring bends it as it spreads, with a bright leading edge, a slight colour split and a flash where it struck.

name: Ground slam
description: A heavy landing seen side-on: cracks shoot across the ground, a ring of dust rolls out, rocks jump and the camera shakes.

name: Impact frame
description: An anime fighting-game impact frame: on each hit the picture punches in, flashes white and flickers inverted or two-tone behind radial speed lines, then recovers.

name: Meteor strike
description: A meteor streaking down through a night sky on a burning trail and hitting the ground in a flash, a fireball and a spreading shockwave dome; it loops and strikes where you click.

name: Screen shake
description: A picture jolted by each hit: it shakes and twists on damped random offsets while a flash and a vignette pulse in the hit colour.

name: Pixel explosion
description: An 8-bit explosion: a white-hot pixel fireball swelling through yellow, orange and red into a ring of smoke, sparks flying out, frame by frame.

name: Hit marker
description: An FPS hit marker whose four diagonal ticks pop in at the crosshair and fade, with a damage number floating up beside it on every click.

name: Comic book
description: Any picture printed as a comic panel: thick inked outlines, flat posterised colour, Ben-Day dots of cyan, magenta and yellow in the mid-tones, slightly off-register on yellowed paper.

name: Cel shade
description: A picture toon-shaded: its brightness stepped into a few crisp bands that keep its colours, with bright highlights and dark inked outlines.

name: Focus lines
description: Manga focus lines: tapering radial speed lines converging on the centre, or the pointer, around a clear middle, flickering and shifting a few times a second.

name: Action lines
description: Comic speed lines streaking across a picture at any angle, with the picture smeared along them, so it reads as rushing past.

name: Sound effect
description: A comic sound effect: a jagged starburst with halftone dots and a lettered word that pops in with an overshoot, shakes from the hit, holds and bursts away, on a loop.

name: Speech bubble
description: A comic speech balloon with a tail that pops out of the speaker and types its words in, or a cloudy thought bubble with trailing circles.

controls.d: 'Comic Neue', 'Comic Sans MS', 'Chalkboard SE', 'Marker Felt', cursive

texts.name: font
texts.label: Font
texts.default: 'Comic Neue', 'Comic Sans MS', 'Chalkboard SE', 'Marker Felt', cursive

name: Fight cloud
description: A cartoon brawl: a churning dust cloud of puffs with fists, boots and stars poking out at random, little impact marks where they land, shaking the whole time.

name: Dizzy stars
description: Cartoon stars (and, if you like, little birds) circling in an ellipse over a dazed head, growing and brightening as they swing round the front and shrinking and fading round the back.

name: Anime emotes
description: Anime and manga emote symbols, picked by number: a pulsing anger vein, a sliding sweat drop, twinkling sparkles or a popping exclamation mark.

name: Cartoon poof
description: A cartoon vanishing act: on each click the object squashes, stretches and disappears into a burst of round smoke puffs that swell and fade among sparkles, then pops back.

name: Line boil
description: Hand-drawn line boil on any path: a turbulence filter whose noise is redrawn a few times a second, so the line jitters like traced animation drawings.

name: Doodle burst
description: A tilted label card that pops in past its size while hand-drawn doodles (triangles, rings, dashes, squiggles and plus signs) burst out round it one after another, linger drifting and twinkling with a line boil, then shrink away and play again.

name: VHS tracking
description: A picture on a cursed tape: the image warping as the tape stretches, a band of tracking noise rolling up through it, head-switching tear along the bottom, colour bleeding to the right and a camcorder's REC and clock burned in.

name: Night vision camcorder
description: A picture through a camcorder's night-vision mode: amplified green phosphor with heavy grain in the shadows, blooming highlights and a dark tube vignette, where pairs of eyes catch the infrared light and shine back out of the dark now and then.

name: Signal lost
description: A live feed that stutters and freezes, breaks into blocky corruption that smears across the frozen frame, shows a hidden picture through the broken blocks, then cuts to static and comes back as if nothing happened. Loops; or turn Animate off and set Moment.

name: Trail cam
description: A picture as an infrared trail camera's stills, a new grainy grey shot every second or so under its flash, with the date and time stamped along the bottom, and a figure in a few of the shots, closer each time.

name: Ghost apparition
description: A translucent figure fading in over a picture as it cools and darkens, flickering, hanging there with hollow eyes and wisps trailing from its hem, then fading away; turn on Double exposure to show a second picture inside it. Loops; or turn Animate off and set Presence.

name: Ectoplasm wisps
description: Glowing green trails of ectoplasm spiralling in out of the dark towards the pointer while it hovers, or a point wandering the frame, each fading as it arrives and another rising in its place.

name: Spirit orbs
description: Pale translucent orbs over a picture, like the ones that turn up in flash photos of haunted houses, drifting like dust and every so often darting off in a streak before drifting on.

name: Eyes in the dark
description: Pairs of glowing eyes opening one after another in the dark, blinking and watching the pointer, snapping shut when it comes near and opening again somewhere else.

name: Creeping dark
description: Darkness with tendril edges slowly closing in from the corners of a picture and drawing back, recoiling from the pointer while it hovers as if from a torch.

name: Shadow hands
description: The shadows of long-fingered hands reaching in over a picture from the edges of the frame one after another, fingers spread, closing on nothing and drawing back.

name: Rust spread
description: Rust breaking out at a few spots on a picture and eating across it along a dark wet front, leaving pitted flaking orange-brown behind, then gone again. Loops; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Mould bloom
description: Fuzzy colonies of mould blooming across a picture one after another, dark-centred and ringed, with white fur at their edges and a yellow stain spreading round them, then wiped clean. Loops; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Wither
description: A picture draining of colour and drying out, cracks splitting across it as its middle caves in and sags, then coming back to life. Loops; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Peeling wallpaper
description: A picture as wallpaper peeling back from a corner along a torn edge, its pale backing curling over, to show a grimy, stained picture underneath, then smoothing back down. Loops; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Aged photo
description: A picture as an old print: faded to sepia, foxed with brown spots, silvered with a bluish sheen in its shadows that shifts with the light, cracked along creases and worn white at the edges.

name: Film burn
description: A picture as projected film that stutters and stalls in the gate, then blisters and melts open from a hot spot, a glowing charred edge spreading out to the bare projector light, before the next reel starts. Loops; or turn Animate off and set Moment.

name: Tentacles
description: Tentacles curling up out of the dark from the bottom of the frame, swaying and coiling at their tips, rows of pale suckers on their undersides, and reaching for the pointer while it hovers.

name: Bat swarm
description: A swarm of bats wheeling across a dusk sky past a full moon, each flapping on its own beat as the flock sweeps back and forth, scattering away from the pointer while it hovers.

name: Passing silhouette
description: A tall, thin figure walking once across the back of a picture, long arms swinging, then gone until the next time round; easy to miss.

name: Summoning circle
description: A glowing sigil drawing itself: a double ring traced round from the top, runes filling the band between, then a star struck point to point, before it flares, a shockwave rolling out, and fades. Loops; or turn Animate off and set Drawn.

name: Cauldron
description: A black iron cauldron with a glowing green brew swirling and bubbling at its brim, bubbles swelling and popping, its light catching the rim as green steam curls up out of it.

name: Candle ring
description: A ring of candles on a dark floor, flames flickering in a pool of their light, until all of them gutter and go out at once, smoke curling up in the dark, before they relight one by one round the ring. Loops; or turn Animate off and set Light.

name: Scare cut
description: A jump scare: a picture slowly closing in, then a sudden cut to a stark face for a split second, the frame punching in and shaking before it settles. Once a cycle, never faster than every three seconds. Loops; or turn Animate off and set Moment.

name: Subliminal flicker
description: A picture that now and then shows something else for a single frame, a hidden picture laid over it so briefly you are not sure you saw it, never more than once every two seconds.

name: Failing light
description: A picture lit by a failing fluorescent tube overhead: humming, catching, stuttering off and back on and sometimes staying dark a while, the room falling into shadow each time. It switches at most three times a second.

name: Heartbeat vignette
description: A deep red edge round a picture pulsing like a heartbeat, quickening and closing in as the pointer gets nearer a target spot, from a resting pulse up to at most 120 beats a minute; while idle, it drifts nearer and away on its own.

name: Blood drip border
description: A glossy band of blood along the top of the frame, drips creeping down from it at their own pace, swelling at their tips and letting drops fall, then thinning away as new ones start; a transparent overlay.

name: Claw slash
description: Claw marks raked across a picture in a fast stroke, each tear ripping open along its length with ragged raw edges and the picture pulled apart round it, holding a moment, then closing up again. Loops; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Blood moon
description: A crimson full moon hanging over dark hills and a lone dead tree, its cratered face glowing through drifting clouds, the sky round it stained red and pricked with faint stars.

name: Possessed text
description: A title that something takes hold of: its letters writhe, twist and float up out of line behind a blood-red haze, then snap back into place all at once as if nothing happened.

name: Rune glow
description: A word carved into dark stone, its letters lighting up one after another with an inner glow as if a spell were being read, pulsing together once all are lit, then fading back into the stone.

name: Bleeding text
description: A title that starts to bleed: blood seeps down through its letters from the top, drips run from its baseline and swell, a few drops fall, then it all fades back to clean letters.

name: Emergency broadcast
description: A fictional emergency alert taking over the screen like an old set switching on: a red header bar, a stark warning wiping on, instructions under it and a blinking footer, under a slow red pulse, then the set switching off.

controls.d: Stay indoors. Cover every window. Do not answer the door, whoever it sounds like.

texts.name: message
texts.label: Message
texts.default: Stay indoors. Cover every window. Do not answer the door, whoever it sounds like.

name: Poltergeist
description: An app screen where something unseen takes hold: a card, a button, an avatar and a toggle tremble, lift off and wobble in the air, then slam back down at once, shaking the screen and puffing up dust.

name: Deep fried
description: A picture fried to a crisp: saturation and contrast blown out, posterised colour, oversharpened halos, JPEG blocking and grain, with red glints flaring from two points such as the eyes.

name: Dramatic zoom
description: A crash zoom onto a point (a face, a stare, a detail) in a few sudden steps, each landing with a kick while a vignette closes in, then a hold and a snap back to the whole picture.

name: Laser eyes
description: Laser beams firing from two eyes over a picture: a white-hot core in a red glow, flaring at each eye and flickering, aimed at any angle and spread, with the picture darkened behind them.

name: To be continued
description: A picture that freezes on a sudden sepia grade with a little punch-in, then a left-pointing arrow slides in at the bottom with its words on it, holds, and it starts over.

name: Needs more JPEG
description: A picture saved again and again at lower quality: 8 × 8 blocks, smeared blocky colour and mosquito noise around its edges grow with each step down, then it snaps back clean and starts over.

name: Triggered
description: A picture tinted red and jittering fast in place, with a banner bar along the bottom carrying its word; the jitter is capped and nothing flashes.

name: Vaporwave grade
description: A picture regraded pink and cyan, with soft scanlines and a split of its colours, a striped sun setting over a moving grid in the lower third, and a strip of glyphs along the top.

name: Galaxy brain
description: Cosmic light radiating from a head that climbs through four levels of enlightenment: a soft halo, then rays, then a nebula full of stars, then a starburst over the whole picture, before it settles and starts again.

name: Sad mode
description: A picture drained to a cool blue-grey with rain streaking down over it, the camera slowly pulling back and a heavy vignette closing in.

name: Game over banner
description: A picture that slows to stuttering frames and drains to grey, then a dark band fades in across it with big serif words on it, growing a little as it holds, before it starts over.

name: Impact caption
description: The classic meme caption: white Impact capitals with a heavy black outline across the top and bottom of the frame, each fitted to the width, popping on with the punchline a beat after the setup.

description: Pixel sunglasses sliding slowly down from the top of the frame onto a pair of eyes, landing with a little bounce, then a caption snapping on underneath.

name: Stonks chart
description: The stonks trope: a jagged line chart rocketing up to a fat arrow head (or crashing down, by a switch), its value ticking up as it draws and a bold label above, laid over a picture or on its own.

name: Error cascade
description: Retro error dialogs popping up one after another, cascading down the screen or dragging a trail across it like a frozen computer, each with an editable title, message and button and no real system's branding.

name: Bonk
description: A cartoon mallet winds up and swings down onto a point, the head under it squashes and springs back, and a comic impact star pops with the word BONK, the frame shaking from the hit.

name: Hitmarker montage
description: A montage-parody volley: hit markers slamming down one after another at points across the frame, a score popping up and floating off each, the frame jolting with every hit and the last one in red.

controls.d: Impact, Anton, 'Haettenschweiler', 'Arial Narrow Bold', 'Arial Black', sans-serif

name: Reaction rain
description: Live-stream reactions floating up the side of the frame: emoji (or any glyphs or words) popping in at the bottom, wobbling as they rise and fading out near the top.

controls.d: 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Noto Color Emoji', 'Twemoji Mozilla', sans-serif

texts.label: Font
texts.default: 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Noto Color Emoji', 'Twemoji Mozilla', sans-serif

name: Word art
description: 90s word art: chunky letters in a rainbow gradient that flows along them, skewed, with a deep 3D extrude growing out behind, set on a wave or an arch, spinning in with a bounce.

name: Volumetric clouds
description: A ray-marched layer of soft, self-shadowed clouds drifting overhead, rimmed with a silver lining toward the sun.

name: Fog banks
description: Horizontal banks of fog drifting at different depths and speeds, thickest near the ground, to lay over any scene.

name: Rising steam
description: Wisps of steam curling up from a cup or vent, thinning and fading as they rise.

name: Mist over image
description: Slow mist drifting over a picture, thickest low down and in the distance, with light softly scattering through it.

name: Sky timelapse
description: A timelapse sky: layers of clouds racing over at different speeds as the light turns from day to golden hour and back.

name: Smoke curl
description: A thin thread of incense or cigarette smoke rising smooth and straight, then breaking into curls and turbulence.

name: Dry ice fog
description: Dense, low stage fog rolling along the floor and spilling over the edge in a slow, tumbling curtain.

name: Aura
description: A silhouette wreathed in an energetic aura, flame-like wisps of light rising off its outline and pulsing.

controls.l: Key out the corner colour (0 off)

name: Bloom
description: A picture whose bright areas bleed soft light into their surroundings, with an optional anamorphic lens streak at any angle.

name: Pulsing halo
description: Soft halo rings behind a centre spot, breathing slowly in and out with a gentle shimmer running round them.

name: Neon outline
description: Any shape or word traced in a crisp neon line with a wide soft glow, its colour flowing along the outline and flickering now and then.

name: Backlight glow
description: A dark silhouette with a light behind it: radiant rays stream past its edges and glow spills round its rim.

controls.l: Key out the corner colour (0 off)

name: Rim light
description: A picture given a coloured studio kicker light along the edges that face a chosen direction.

name: Glow ring pulse
description: Glowing rings pulsing out from a softly breathing core in endless waves, like a beacon or a live indicator.

name: Glow button
description: A pill button with a soft glow that, on hover, brightens, spreads its glow wider and lifts a little.

name: Long shadow
description: The flat-design long shadow: a word or icon casting a long diagonal band across a flat colour, fading along its length and slowly swinging round.

name: Drop shadow lift
description: A logo or icon resting on a soft drop shadow that lifts off the page when hovered, its shadow growing larger, softer and further below as it scales up.

name: Light sweep shadows
description: A coloured light drifting across a floor of shapes (or following the pointer), each casting a real soft shadow that swings round as the light moves.

name: Contact shadow
description: An object floating up and down above the floor, its contact shadow tightening and darkening as it nears the ground and spreading and fading as it rises.

name: Window shadows
description: Warm sunlight through a window falling across a wall or a picture, dappled by the shadows of slowly tilting blinds or rustling leaves.

name: Shadow puppets
description: Hand shadow puppets on a lamp-lit wall: a flapping bird, a barking dog or a twitching rabbit, softening as the hand moves away from the wall.

controls.l: Hand moving to and from the wall

name: Floor reflection
description: A picture or logo standing on a glossy floor, its mirror image beneath fading and softening with distance, under a soft spotlight; wet floors ripple it.

name: Lift card
description: A content card that lifts toward you on hover like a material elevation change, rising and growing slightly as its shadow spreads and softens beneath it.

name: Exploded layers
description: An isometric UI card whose layers (shadow plate, card base, image and text lines, floating badge) lift apart one after another, showing the gaps and the soft shadows between them, hold, then settle back together.

name: Twirl
description: A picture twisted into a swirl that winds and unwinds around the pointer or a centre, strongest in the middle.

name: Pinch & bulge
description: A picture swelling out like a bubble or sucked in to a point around the pointer or a centre.

name: Fisheye
description: A picture seen through a fisheye lens, bulging in the middle and curving to the corners, over the whole frame or in a round lens.

name: Mirror tiles
description: A picture folded into mirrored kaleidoscope tiles, square or hexagonal, slowly turning and drifting.

name: Wave warp
description: A picture rippling in sine waves sideways, up and down or both, like a flag or a reflection on water, with lit crests.

name: Ribbed glass
description: A picture seen through fluted glass: strips of refracted image with bright and dark rib edges, clear or frosted.

name: Shower glass
description: A picture blurred and bent behind textured shower-door glass, pebbled or streaked with rain, catching small highlights.

name: Datamosh
description: A picture breaking down like a corrupted video stream in bursts: macroblocks smear along a false motion field, stick in the wrong place and bleed colour.

name: Polar warp
description: A picture wrapped into a circle, as a tiny planet or a tunnel, or a circle unrolled into a strip, slowly turning.

name: Texture displace
description: A picture pushed around by a second, scrolling texture, by its red and green or by its light and shade.

controls.l: Push by brightness slope (else by red/green)

name: Corner pin
description: A picture pinned by its four corners anywhere in the frame, in true perspective, for screen replacements, signs and mock-ups.

name: Crystal ball
description: A crystal ball over a picture showing it flipped and magnified, with colour fringes at its rim, a bright highlight and a focused spot of light in its shadow; it follows the pointer.

controls.l: Flip the view (as a solid ball does)

name: Glass blocks
description: A picture seen through a wall of glass bricks: each block squeezes and ripples its own piece of the view, set in pale mortar.

name: Cracked glass
description: A picture behind a pane that cracks into a spider web from the centre and wherever you click, its shards slightly out of line and the cracks catching the light.

controls.l: Crack the centre on a loop

name: Infinity mirror
description: A picture repeated inside itself as a tunnel of reflections, each one smaller, darker and more tinted, with a ring of lights between them, drifting endlessly inward.

name: Funhouse mirror
description: A picture in a gilt-framed oval funhouse mirror that stretches it tall or squat and rolls it through slow wavy bulges, a sheen sliding across the glass.

name: Spectrum bars
description: Classic equaliser bars dancing to the music, with peak caps kicked up on each beat and an optional mirrored layout.

name: Circular spectrum
description: A ring of spectrum bars radiating round a centre picture or colour, which swells on the bass.

name: Waveform line
description: A smooth glowing oscilloscope line drawn from the music's spectrum, with fainter echoes trailing it.

name: Bass pulse
description: A picture or logo thumping to the bass: it swells and glows on every kick, with a colour split on the beat.

name: Audio particles
description: Sparks bursting outward from the centre on every beat, trailing and fading, over a core that breathes with the level.

name: Audio plasma
description: A flowing plasma whose swirl, scale and colours follow the bass, mids and highs, flaring on each beat.

name: Vinyl
description: A record spinning on a turntable, its label a picture, its grooves catching the light with the music, the tonearm riding the beat.

name: Scroll reveal
description: A picture revealed by a soft wipe, dissolve, iris or blinds as it scrolls into view, settling from a slight zoom.

name: Parallax layers
description: Layered hills under a sky, the near ones sliding further than the far ones as the page scrolls, for depth.

name: Scroll progress glow
description: A reading-progress bar along the top of the page, filling as you scroll, its glowing head flaring while you move.

name: Scroll velocity blur
description: A picture smeared with motion blur and a colour split as fast as the page scrolls, sharp again when it stops.

name: Scroll zoom
description: A picture zooming in (or out) and drifting as it passes through the viewport, with an optional turn and vignette.

name: Scroll draw
description: A line drawing itself along its path as the page scrolls, a dot riding its tip, and undrawing as you scroll back.

name: Scroll counter
description: A big number counting up as it scrolls into view, with its label and a line growing under it.

name: Scroll steps
description: Four step markers joined by a line that fills as you scroll, each marker lighting up as the line reaches it.

name: Lower third
description: A name bar and a title bar sliding out from an accent stripe in the lower left, holding, then sliding back.

name: Stacked lower third
description: A logo tile popping in, then a panel sliding out from behind it with a name over a title, divided by a drawn rule.

name: Title card
description: A big centred title rising in, a line drawing out from the middle beneath it and a subtitle following, then a wipe or fade out.

name: Logo reveal
description: A logo mark tracing its outline on and filling, the wordmark wiping in beside it, a tagline rising, then a shine sweeping across.

name: Logo sting
description: A quick, punchy logo hit: a flash, burst lines and a shock ring firing out as the logo pops in with an overshoot, then snaps away.

name: End card
description: An outro screen: a thank-you title, two video placeholders scaling in for end-screen links, and a subscribe button that pops.

name: Countdown
description: A countdown from ten (or any number) to zero, the number flipping over each second as a ring drains around it.

name: Subscribe button
description: A YouTube-style subscribe button: a cursor glides in and clicks it, it turns grey and reads Subscribed, and a bell pops up and rings.

name: News ticker
description: A news band along the bottom with a BREAKING label and a blinking live dot, its headlines crawling past in a seamless loop.

controls.d: Markets close higher as rates hold steady  ·  Storm warning lifted along the coast  ·  City council approves new transit line

name: Scoreboard
description: A sports score bug wiping in at the top left: team names and colours, scores counting up, a ticking match clock and the period.

name: Chapter marker
description: A numbered badge spinning in at the lower left and a panel sliding out of it with the chapter label over its title.

name: Hand circle
description: A hand-drawn, slightly wobbly marker circle drawing itself round a region in a rough double stroke, then fading.

name: Hand arrow
description: A handwritten label, then a curved, hand-drawn arrow drawing itself from it to a target point.

controls.d: 'Caveat', 'Patrick Hand', 'Segoe Print', 'Bradley Hand', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive

name: Callout
description: A dot pops on a target and pulses, a leader line draws out from it and a label box pops in at its end.

name: Bracket note
description: A curly bracket drawing itself down the side of a region, then a handwritten note beside its point.

name: Scribble out
description: A word scribbled out in a back-and-forth cross-hatch, then a replacement handwritten beside it.
