name: Redact box
description: Black redaction bars drawn line by line over part of a screenshot or video, then a REDACTED stamp slammed on top.

name: Step badges
description: Numbered step badges popping in one after another at points on a screen, each with a label sliding out beside it.

name: Focus box
description: A spotlight dimming a screen everywhere but a rounded box, which glides from one region to the next and the next.

name: Fake cursor
description: A product-demo cursor over a screen: it glides to a point and clicks with a ripple, drags out a selection, then clicks a text field and types.

name: Tooltip tour
description: A guided-tour tooltip moving between three highlighted spots on a screen, its text changing with a 1/3, 2/3, 3/3 counter and a progress dot.

name: Border beam
description: A bright beam of light travelling round a card's rounded border, trailing a gradient tail.

name: Gradient border
description: A rounded card ringed by a turning conic gradient, glowing softly round the outside.

name: Meteors
description: Thin meteor streaks falling diagonally across, each trailing a fading tail.

name: Background beams
description: Faint curved paths fanning across a dark background, with gradient pulses of light flowing along them.

name: Grid spotlight
description: A faint line grid that brightens and glows round the pointer while hovered, fading out at the edges.

name: Dot grid
description: A field of dots that swell and glow near the pointer, rippling in a gentle wave while idle.

name: Glass card
description: A frosted glass card floating over a picture: the picture blurred behind it, a bright edge, a soft shadow and fine grain.

name: Liquid glass
description: A liquid glass pill over a picture that bends and magnifies what is behind it, with a bright rim, following the pointer.

name: Grainy glow background
description: A few soft, blurred colour orbs drifting on a plain background under film grain: the grainy hero background.

name: Metal card
description: A brushed-metal payment card that tilts toward the pointer, a streak of light sliding along its grain over the chip, the contactless mark and embossed digits.

name: Card spotlight
description: A bento grid of dark cards whose borders and faces light up near the pointer, one soft spotlight bleeding across the card edges and the gaps between.

name: Dichroic glass
description: Overlapping panes of dichroic glass over a picture, each tinting what is behind it a colour that shifts across the pane and with the pointer, reflecting the opposite colour at its edges.

controls.l: Tilt on its own when idle

name: Marquee
description: An endless row of logos or words scrolling sideways, looping seamlessly and fading out at both edges.

controls.d: Acme · Globex · Initech · Umbrella · Hooli · Stark

name: Number ticker
description: A number rolling up digit by digit like an odometer, in any format: $12,480, 98.6%, 1,024 users.

name: Animated badge
description: A small "New" pill with a gradient fill, a shimmer sweeping across it and a sparkle popping at its corner.

name: Swipe stack
description: A dating-app stack of cards: the top one is dragged and flung off to one side or the other under a LIKE or NOPE stamp, and the cards beneath move up to take its place.

name: Pack opening
description: A foil booster pack shaking, its top tearing off and a hand of trading cards rising out of it and fanning open, the rare one in the middle lifting, glowing and catching a holographic shine.

name: App window
description: A neo-brutalist app window with a coloured title bar, three dots and a hard offset shadow springing in at a tilt, its progress ring filling and drawing a tick as the label changes to done.

name: Globe
description: A spinning Earth-like globe, dotted or realistic, with glowing arcs travelling between cities and an atmosphere rim; drag it to turn it.

name: Rotating shapes
description: A torus, a rounded cube and an icosahedron floating and turning in a soft-lit studio, casting soft shadows on the backdrop.

name: Isometric city
description: An isometric block city whose buildings rise out of the ground, drifting through day and night as windows, street lights and traffic come on.

name: Wireframe terrain
description: A fly-over of a glowing wireframe mesh of hills and valleys, the lines coloured by height and fading into fog on the horizon.

name: 3D metaballs
description: Glossy 3D metaballs drifting, merging and pulling apart like liquid, reflecting a soft studio around them.

name: Torus knot
description: A glowing torus knot tube turning slowly, its surface shimmering with iridescent thin-film colour.

name: Cover flow
description: A ring of picture cards turning in perspective, stepping round so each comes to the front in turn, mirrored on a glossy floor.

name: Gemstone
description: A brilliant-cut gem seen from above, turning slowly so its facets flash white and throw sparks of rainbow fire, with star glints.

name: Rain streaks
description: Rain falling in slanted streaks at several depths, splashing where it meets a ground line, to lay over any scene.

name: Thunderstorm
description: Dark, roiling storm clouds lit from inside by flickering lightning, with bolts to the ground and driving rain.

name: Rainbow
description: A soft rainbow arc fading in over a picture as if after rain, with a faint second bow and optional sun rays.

name: Wind gust
description: Gusts of wind sweeping across: curling wind lines with leaves and dust tumbling along, to lay over any scene.

name: Hail
description: Hailstones pelting down and bouncing on a ground line, each bounce lower than the last, to lay over any scene.

name: Ocean waves
description: An open ocean at sunset or by day: layered, sharp-crested waves rolling in, foam on the crests, the sky in the water and a glint of sun.

name: Underwater scene
description: Looking out under water: shafts of light from the rippling surface, caustics dancing on a sandy floor, drifting particles and deep blue fog.

name: Pond ripples
description: Raindrops landing on a picture as if it lay under a pond, each spreading rings that bend the picture beneath; clicks drop stones that ripple wider.

name: Waterfall
description: A stylised waterfall pouring over a cliff between mossy rocks into a churning plunge pool, wrapped in rising mist.

name: Water reflection
description: A picture above a stretch of water that mirrors it, the reflection broken by ripples that shrink towards the horizon, tinted by the water and glinting.

controls.l: Lift the picture to stand on the water line

name: Liquid morph
description: Both images swept along a flowing, swirling current that peaks half way, dissolving one into the other like ink in water.

name: Displacement
description: Each image's brightness pushes it out in one direction as the next slides in, warped by its own light and dark.

name: Luma fade
description: Pixels switch to the next image in order of brightness, shadows first or highlights first, along a soft edge.

name: Particle swap
description: The image breaks into square particles that tumble along curved, staggered paths and land as the next image.

name: Ink bleed
description: The next image bleeds through the first like wet ink on paper, spreading from a few seeds with dark, pooled edges.

name: Whip pan
description: A beat-cut whip pan or zoom punch: the first image flies off in a motion blur that peaks at the cut, and the next one lands from the other side.

name: Pixel dissolve
description: The picture pixelates up to big blocks, the blocks swap to the next image in a random order, then it resolves into the new picture. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Screen melt
description: The classic shooter's screen melt: the old picture's columns slide down off the screen at ragged, staggered speeds, uncovering the next one. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Pixel block wipe
description: An 8-bit block wipe: big squares grow in steps to cover the picture in a diagonal, spiral, closing-iris or random order, then shrink away to show the next one. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Comic panels
description: The next picture arrives panel by panel: the frame splits into comic panels with white gutters and black borders, each panel wipes, slides or pops to the new picture in turn, then the gutters close.

name: Mirror fold
description: One picture folds back like a page whose underside is a mirror, the fold sweeping across to reveal the next, the mirrored flap reflecting it as it goes. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Knockout wipe
description: A slanted cut with a bright edge sweeping across a picture, knocking its background out to a transparency checkerboard and leaving the cut-out standing, like a background-removal reveal. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Claw tear
description: Claw marks rip across the first picture and tear wider, raw-edged, until the next picture fills the frame through them. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Blood wipe
description: A curtain of blood pours down over the first picture, drips running ahead of it, then drains away from the top to show the next. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Shadow swallow
description: Darkness with tendril edges closes in from the corners and swallows the first picture, a pair of eyes glinting in it for a moment, then draws back to show the next. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Static cut
description: The first picture tears and rolls as the signal goes, breaks into TV static, then the next picture tunes in out of it. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Burn through
description: The first picture blisters and burns through from a hot spot, a glowing charred edge spreading out across the frame and the next picture showing through the hole. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Wipe
description: A soft-edged wipe from one image to the next. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Iris
description: A circle opening from the centre onto the next image. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Block dissolve
description: Random blocks switching to the next image. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Grid wipe
description: A diagonal cascade of cells revealing the next image. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Glass wipe
description: A refracting glass edge sweeping across. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Twister
description: A swirl that twists one image into the next. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Light leak
description: A warm flare of light burning through to the next image. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Cross zoom
description: A zoom blur punching through to the next image. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Liquid loader
description: A glass circle filling with sloshing liquid, two waves rolling across its surface and bubbles rising, then draining to fill again.

name: Glow ring spinner
description: A ring of light sweeping round with a soft glowing gradient tail, its tail stretching and shrinking as it turns.

name: Metaball loader
description: Gooey blobs chasing each other round a circle, stretching apart and merging back together as they pass.

name: Flame loader
description: A progress bar that burns along its length: the filled part glows like embers under flames, tallest at the leading edge, sparks flying off it.

name: Spinner
description: An arc chasing its tail: the classic indeterminate loader.

name: Bouncing dots
description: Three dots hopping in turn, for typing indicators and loaders.

name: Pulse ping
description: Rings radiating from a dot, like a live indicator or radar ping.

name: Equalizer
description: Audio level bars dancing, for now-playing badges and voice states.

name: Progress ring
description: A ring filling up to a percentage while the number counts with it.

name: Upload card
description: An image upload card whose progress bar fills as the percentage counts to 100%, then the placeholder cross-fades into the finished picture with a check, and resets.

name: Battery charge
description: A battery filling cell by cell as its percentage counts up and the bolt pulses, flashing when it is full.

name: Chomp loader
description: A chomping pixel mouth munching along a row of dots between maze walls, as a looping loader.

name: Snake loader
description: A pixel snake running laps round the edge of a phone-LCD board a cell at a time, eating the food in its path, as a looping loader.

name: Bubble pop loader
description: A loader of four bubbles inflating in turn and popping into droplets, over and over.

name: Skeleton shimmer
description: A skeleton placeholder card (avatar, lines, picture block) with a shimmer of light sweeping across it while content loads.

name: Progress bar
description: A striped progress bar filling to a value while its percentage counts up, the stripes marching all the while.

name: Indeterminate bar
description: A Material-style indeterminate progress bar: two segments racing across the track, one long and one short.

name: Step progress
description: A four-step stepper filling in turn: each step turns solid with a check and the line to the next one fills.

name: Circle dots loader
description: Dots chasing each other round a circle, bunching and spreading as they go, each with a fading trail.

name: Wave bars
description: A row of rounded bars rising and falling in a wave that runs from left to right, shading from one colour to another.

name: Hourglass
description: An hourglass whose sand runs from the top bulb into the bottom in a thin stream, then the glass turns over to run again.

name: Infinity loader
description: A glowing dash chasing itself round a figure of eight, stretching as it swings through the crossing.

name: Orbit loader
description: Three dots circling a pulsing centre on tilted orbits, like an atom, each a third of a turn behind the last.

name: Shape morph loader
description: A shape that turns as it morphs from a square into a circle, a triangle and back, changing colour with each.

name: Riffle shuffle
description: A deck of cards cut in two and riffled back together, the cards dropping in from either side in turn before the deck is tapped square, over and over.

name: Spider web loader
description: A spider web weaving itself spoke by spoke and round its spiral, then a spider dropping in on its thread, bobbing, and climbing back out as the web fades.

name: Coffin loader
description: A coffin whose lid jolts, then creaks open to show a pair of eyes in the dark that blink, before it slams shut again in a puff of dust.

name: Candle burndown
description: A candle burning down to a stub as its flame flickers and wax pools at its base, then blowing out in a curl of smoke and fading back to a fresh one.

name: Ghost loader
description: A little ghost floating round in a circle, its hem rippling and fainter copies of it trailing behind, blinking now and then.

name: Skeleton hand loader
description: A bony skeleton hand drumming its fingers on a table one after another, little finger to index, waiting impatiently.

name: Bar chart
description: Bars growing into place one after another, values counting above them.

name: Line chart
description: A trend line drawing across with a marker riding its tip and the area fading in below.

name: Stat counter
description: A headline number counting up, with its caption and underline sweeping in.

name: Route
description: A dashed journey drawing between two pins, with a traveller following it.

name: Timeline track
description: A vertical line drawing down with nodes popping along milestones.

name: Flow network
description: A node graph linking up, then a glowing critical path racing through it to a pulsing hub.

name: Donut chart
description: Segments sweeping round a ring one after another, a legend giving each share, and the total counting up in the middle.

name: Pie chart
description: Pie slices popping out one at a time and settling into place, each with its percentage, beside a legend.

name: Gauge
description: A speedometer gauge: its coloured band draws on, the needle sweeps past the value and settles, and the reading counts up beneath.

name: Bar race
description: A bar chart race: bars stretch and overtake each other, swapping places as the period label ticks through the years.

name: Sparkline
description: A tiny trend line drawing in with a dot riding its tip, which then pulses beside the latest value; small enough to sit in a line of text.

name: Leaderboard
description: Ranked rows sliding into place from the bottom up, each with an initials avatar and a score counting up, then a highlight on the winner.

name: Area chart
description: A stacked area chart whose layers rise together from the baseline, then a tooltip line glides across reading the total.

name: KPI tile
description: A dashboard tile: the headline figure counts up, a delta arrow shows the change in green or red by its sign, and a mini sparkline draws in.

name: Rolodex
description: Cards on a rolodex spindle flipping down one after another, each showing a figure and its label, for rotating stats, quotes or names.

controls.d: signed up this month, on the App Store, over the last year, and counting

texts.label: Labels (comma separated)
texts.default: signed up this month, on the App Store, over the last year, and counting

name: Success check
description: A circle drawing itself closed, then a tick, then a little pop.

name: Error cross
description: A circle and a cross drawing on, with a short shake.

name: Heartbeat
description: A heart beating twice, with an ECG line tracing beneath it.

name: Signature
description: A handwritten flourish drawing itself as if by pen.

name: Confetti burst
description: A burst of confetti flying out and fluttering down.

name: Pixel weather
description: A 16 × 16 pixel-art weather icon: a sun flicking its rays, partly cloudy, a bobbing cloud, rain or snow falling in steps, or a thunderbolt flashing under a dark cloud.

controls.l: Weather (sun, partly cloudy, cloudy, rain, thunder, snow)

name: Weather icons
description: An animated weather icon: sun with turning rays, partly cloudy, drifting clouds, falling rain, a flashing thunderbolt, snow or gusting wind.

controls.l: Weather (sun, partly cloudy, cloudy, rain, thunder, snow, wind)

name: Notification bell
description: A bell ringing with a damped swing and its clapper lagging behind, as a badge pops on with the unread count.

name: Animated arrows
description: An arrow icon set: an arrow nudging right, chevrons cascading down, refresh arrows turning, or an external-link arrow leaving its box.

name: Emoji reactions
description: A reaction picker: on hover the bar opens and like, love, haha, wow, sad and angry faces bounce up one after another, drawn as vectors.

name: Star rating
description: Five stars that fill one after another on hover, each bouncing as it fills (halves too), while the rating counts up beside them.

name: Trash delete
description: A trash can whose lid flips open as a crumpled paper drops in, then snaps shut with a little wobble; replays on every click.

name: Lock and unlock
description: A padlock: a click turns a key and pops the shackle open as the lock turns green; the next click turns it back and snaps it shut.

name: Wi-Fi signal
description: Wi-Fi bars filling one after another from the dot outward, pulsing twice at full strength, then fading to start again.

name: Wish star
description: A shooting star swoops down an arc, spinning, its trail drawing on behind it, then lands with a pop and a burst of twinkling sparkles as the trail fades.

name: Jack-o'-lantern
description: A carved pumpkin with a candle flickering inside, its face glowing and dimming unevenly and its light breathing round it.

name: Bat flap
description: A bat beating its scalloped wings, rising a little with each beat.

name: Skull chatter
description: A skull whose jaw chatters open and shut, its eye sockets glowing red for a moment as it does.
